description.p: Veranda is a modern, GNOME-native manager for Elgato Stream Deck devices. Drag actions onto keys to launch apps, run commands, press hotkeys, type text, open URLs and folders, or build multi-step macros — and arrange them across pages and profiles.

Live "Special Buttons" turn keys into glanceable widgets — clock, date, now-playing, battery, volume, system load, network, weather, and more — that update on a timer or on desktop events. Keys can show symbolic icons, uploaded images, or animated GIFs, with per-tile colors drawn from your GNOME theme.

Veranda integrates deeply with GNOME: it runs in the background with a tray entry, ships an optional Quick Settings extension, exposes profiles to the Activities overview search, and can be driven from the command line.
